notes.title: Sky Dreamer launches on August 4, 2025
notes.notes: [p]I’m beyond excited to finally announce the official release date: [b]Sky Dreamer[/b] is coming to Steam on [b]August 4, 2025[/b]![/p][p]Sky Dreamer is a sci-fi-inspired productivity app that combines a Pomodoro timer with a relaxing idle game. Each focus session helps a floating city grow — visually rewarding and deeply motivating.[/p][p][b]What you can expect:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Distraction-free Pomodoro flow[/b] – four clearly structured focus phases with smooth breaks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cities that grow[/b] – the more you focus, the more vibrant and alive your city becomes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Energy system & rewards[/b] – spend earned energy to unlock new buildings, visual styles, and sky gradients.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No microtransactions[/b] – everything is unlocked through focus time.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you're looking for a peaceful, inspiring way to stay focused — or just love cozy sci-fi vibes — [b]add Sky Dreamer to your wishlist now[/b]. I can’t wait to share this with you![/p]

notes.title: Kawaii Spaceships Incoming! 💙✨
notes.notes:
[p]The skies of [i]Sky Dreamer[/i] just got a whole lot cuter![/p][p]
I’ve added a collection of kawaii little spaceships that gently float through your focus sessions.
They drift peacefully above your city – playful, kind, and full of charm. 🐰🛸☁️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416005/cd3ec7bfc2821ef8be394e5be2327fe302ed9b18.png"][/img][/p][p]For me, these tiny companions are more than decoration – they’re here to bring a smile and add a calming presence to your day.[/p][p]
Whether you’re working, studying, or simply taking a mindful break:
Your sky is alive – and it’s cheering you on. 💫[/p][p]I truly hope you enjoy these new designs as much as I enjoyed creating them. 💙[/p]

notes.title: Sky Dreamer is part of the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Sky Dreamer is officially part of the Steam Next Fest!
From June 9 to 16, you can try out the demo for free and dive into a relaxing sci-fi world that’s all about focus, growth, and rewarding progress.

What to expect:
✨ Gamified Pomodoro-style focus sessions
🏙️ A growing sky city that reacts to your time
🚀 Floating spaceships and a calm, atmospheric vibe
🔓 Unlockable content and your first Steam achievements

Sky Dreamer isn’t just a game – it’s a mindful companion that supports your focus in a beautiful, cozy setting.
Help me with the launch by playing the demo and adding the game to your wishlist!

Try the demo now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672070/Sky_Dreamer_Demo/

Thanks so much for your support,
– Mario

Hello everyone,

I'm excited to announce that the Sky Dreamer demo is now available!

Sky Dreamer combines the Pomodoro technique with a relaxing sci-fi world full of floating cities and steady growth.

Collect energy through focused work sessions

Enjoy the calming drift of clouds and passing spaceships

I'm really looking forward to hearing your feedback!
If you enjoy Sky Dreamer, please add it to your wishlist to stay updated and not miss the full release.

Thank you so much for your support,

notes.title: Sky Dreamer – Add to your wishlist now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416005/a22391f856d1638d0c9c926addcd78ef96e19d2f.jpg[/img]

Today I’d like to give you a first look at my new game, Sky Dreamer.
Sky Dreamer is a gamified productivity app with a sci-fi atmosphere, designed to help you stay focused using the Pomodoro technique – paired with relaxing, visual feedback.

As you concentrate, futuristic buildings grow in your floating city.
Clouds drift across the sky, spaceships fly by – and with every session, you earn energy that can be spent on unlocking new designs, cities, or visual effects.

Each category you create becomes its own unique city – and every focus session helps it grow a little more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416005/e2d798e93911739f19c26fd36b4b5567ffa438c7.jpg[/img]

The release is planned for this fall.
Until then, you can support the project by adding it to your wishlist – it helps a lot and ensures you won’t miss the launch.

Thanks so much for your support,
– Mario
